name: Power Skip
steps: Stand tall at the beginning of a clear lane with your elbows bent in a running position.
Push off one foot and drive the opposite knee and the arm on the takeoff side upward.
Land on the takeoff foot, step onto the other foot and skip upward again, alternating sides as you move forward.
Reduce the height of the skips and walk to a stop.
tips: Drive upward through the ankle, knee and hip of the supporting leg.
Land beneath your hips so you can spring smoothly into the next step.
